    (hroot : a ^ 2 - (b + c) * a + c * b = 0) :

      ring_nf

      <;>
      ring_nf at *
      <;>
      norm_num
      <;>
      constructor <;>
      simp_all [Complex.ext_iff, pow_two, mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] <;>
      nlinarith
    rw [h₃] at h₂
    exact h₂
  
  have h₂ : (a - d) * (a - c) * (a - b) = 0 := by
